newsitem.title: UK: LME copper touch firmer late after poor close.
newsitem.headline: LME copper touch firmer late after poor close.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) three months copper edged up in inter-office trading on Thursday after ending on the day's lows at the afternoon kerb close.
By 1900 GMT when Comex ended, LME copper was bid at $2,187, versus a kerb close of $2,179 which was down $29 from Wednesday.
Price had veered lower during late LME trading to below the $2,200 level, and with spread backwardations also softening the market notched up a poor technical close, traders said.
Business was patchy and attention was focused on Friday's LME stocks data, as the market anticipated another build as metal is delivered into U.S. and Singapore stores.
